content:
Sara Patel: Heads up — collision on the 10:00 PDT release slot (train A). Data-service and Search teams both queued. Can we re-slot? Details: Data-service PR #5421 (schema tweak, fast migrate) wants 10:00, Search PR #5567 (embedding index update) also 10:00.
James Miller: we can move Search to 10:30 if it helps. 10:30 or 11:00 works for us. @Sara Patel is 10:30 ok?
Alejandro Cruz: migration? Data-service requires a quick DB migration that needs read-only for 2-3 min. If you move Search we should ensure we don't overlap the read-only window. Who's owning rollback for Data-service?
Katie Liu: I can be smoke owner for Search at 10:30. checklist: smoke-runner, query sanity, embeddings checksum. I'll run actuator tests. assign me in the sheet.
DevOps Bot: Scheduling conflict detected. Proposed resolution: Data-service @10:00-10:05, Search @10:20-10:25. Canary ramp for Search at +10% for 5m. Would you like me to apply the adjusted windows? [yes/no]
Sara Patel: @DevOps Bot please apply the proposed windows. @{James Miller} can you confirm 10:20 works? Data-service team @Alejandro Cruz will keep migration at 10:00-10:03 read-only. We want no overlap in heavy indexing.
James Miller: 10:20 is fine. We'll push the index job to 10:20 and keep a 5m low-rate ramp. :thumbsup:
Alejandro Cruz: OK. Rollback plan for Data-service: If migration fails, run rollback script (link). I posted the steps: ```bash
./scripts/db-rollback.sh --env prod --point-before 2026-03-18T09:59:00Z
``` Will tag @oncall if something unexpected.
Katie Liu: Search smoke checklist in case someone else needs it: 1) smoke queries, 2) embedding sample compare, 3) latency perf, 4) telemetry: error spikes. I'll attach results in the release sheet after 10:25.
Sara Patel: Also quick ask — PR #5421 still needs one small CR (schema comment). @Tom Hayes can you do a quick review? It's tiny.
Tom Hayes: on it, will review in 10 mins.
James Miller: noting that Search has a rolling restart step: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/search-worker -n prod``` — I'll run it after 10:20 ramp. Informing SRE.
SRE Pager: FYI scheduled maintenance window updated.
DevOps Bot: Windows applied: Data-service 2026-03-18T17:00:00Z (10:00 PDT) length 5m; Search 2026-03-18T17:20:00Z length 10m. Canary ramp: Search 10% for 5m then 50% for 3m. No overlapping read-only windows.
Sara Patel: Perfect. If smoke passes, we'll mark both deployed and close the train ticket. Thanks everyone.
James Miller: Thanks — will post smoke results.
Tom Hayes: Reviewed and approved #5421. :white_check_mark:
Alejandro Cruz: Migration verified locally, rollback script tested. Standby.
Katie Liu: Smoke pass for Search: queries OK, embeddings match, latency normal. I'll upload screenshots. :tada:
Sara Patel: Closing this slot. I'll update the release board. Great coordination.
